sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (2011). Change Request Number 2011-076: adopted merge [sca] into [hle] Hlersu (effective 2012-02-03). Dallas: SIL International.

sources.note: Nothing; administrative document establishing that Sansu = Hlersu (alternate name, same group, self-identify as Hlersu; no Sansu language found in Myanmar).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (2007). Change Request Number 2007-089: adopted create [hle] Hlersu (2008-01-14). Requester J. Pelkey, supported by D. Bradley. Dallas: SIL International.

sources.note: Nothing; identifies Hlersu as a distinct Central Ngwi language (Bradley 2004, 2007), not mutually intelligible with Nisu.
